scraped.title: Promoting Dialogue and Participation
scraped.subtitle: Promoting Dialogue and Participation (PDP)
scraped.description: The “Promoting Dialogue and Participation in Iraq (PDP)” programme, commissioned by BMZ and implemented by GIZ in cooperation with the Iraqi Ministry of Planning, aims to foster inclusive dialogue and participation in response to Iraq’s ongoing political, economic, and social…
body: The “Promoting Dialogue and Participation in Iraq (PDP)” programme, commissioned by BMZ and implemented by GIZ in cooperation with the Iraqi Ministry of Planning, aims to foster inclusive dialogue and participation in response to Iraq’s ongoing political, economic, and social challenges. It supports the development of reform-oriented dialogue formats involving civil society, government, academia, and the private sector, with a strong focus on youth and women. Additionally, the project strengthens the capacities of local actors such as civil society organizations, think tanks, and universities to contribute evidence-based input to these processes.

ICON supported the PDP project in the preparation, planning, and implementation of ten event formats across Iraq and the broader Middle East region, including Turkey and Jordan. This included two climate change-focused events in Baghdad and Erbil. Additionally, ICON organized six events on dialogue, participation, good governance, gender, and strategic advice within the framework of the Technical Working Group for Dialogue and Participation, facilitating exchange among representatives from government, academia, and civil society. ICON also assisted in identifying and inviting relevant stakeholders to ensure meaningful and inclusive participation in all events.
